description: This is a CMake module script defining a function `compile_aidl` which automates the process of invoking the aidl compiler to generate source code from aidl files during the build process. The script includes parsing arguments, locating the aidl executable, setting default and user-specified options, and executing the command to produce source and header files based on aidl files.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: A CMake function to compile aidl files into source code, with configurable options for aidl executable path, language, include directories, target output directory, and additional aidl flags.
